svg.text: CONFIDENTIAL AI & GPU TEE ARCHITECTURE: H200 PPCIE & BLACKWELL INLINE LINE-RATE TEE
H200 PPCIE + CUDA Graph Retains 95.2% Bare-Metal Speed; Blackwell Inline TEE Hits 98.4%
8-GPU Confidential VM (SEV-SNP/TDX + GPU TEE): Tier 1 Naive CC-On (53.5% Tax) vs. Tier 3 H200 PPCIE (4.8% Tax) vs. Tier 4 B200 (1.6% Tax)
⛔ Tier 1 Trap: Why Naive GPU TEE Loses 53.5% Speed
1. The `SWIOTLB` PCIe Bounce Buffer & AES-GCM Encryption Bottleneck:
• In `CC-On` mode, all Host-to-GPU PCIe DMA must be encrypted in
software/copy-engine via shared bounce buffers (`~4–8 GB/s` cap!)
2. Fatal Mistakes Inside a GPU TEE (`Host KV Swap` & `Eager Mode`):
• Swapping multi-GB KV Cache to Host DRAM or launching 650 eager
kernels/token over encrypted PCIe throttles GPU SMs by `53.5%`!
3. Un-Attested Weight Decryption Before TEE Verification:
• Mounting plaintext model weights on host disk leaks IP to cloud ops
Tier 1 Naive GPU TEE Failure Impact (70B LLM):
• Throughput Retention vs. Bare Metal: Only 46.5% (-53.5% tax!)
• P99 Decode TPOT: 34.8 ms (PCIe encryption bottleneck)
• Cost per 1M Confidential Tokens: $1.12 / 1M
🏆 Tier 3/4: H200 PPCIE (`95.2%`) & Blackwell TEE (`98.4%`)
1. Keep 100% of Weights & KV Inside HBM + Mandatory `CUDA Graph`:
• Only tiny input/output token IDs (`<32 KB/req`) cross encrypted
PCIe—shrinking Hopper TEE overhead from `53.5%` to `<4.8%`!
2. Multi-GPU `PPCIE` (Protected PCIe + Encrypted NVLink) & `TDISP`:
• `H200 PPCIE` encrypts 8-GPU NVLink traffic; `Blackwell B200` adds
dedicated hardware inline encryption engines (`98.4%` speed!)
3. Dual Hardware Remote Attestation (`SEV-SNP/TDX + NVIDIA NRAS`):
• KMS releases AES-256 weight decryption key only into verified TEE
Verified Production Benchmarks (Tier 3 H200 / Tier 4 B200):
• Bare-Metal Speed Retention: 95.2% (H200 PPCIE) / 98.4% (B200)
• P99 Decode TPOT: 14.4 ms (H200) / 8.2 ms (B200)
• Cost per 1M Confidential Tokens: $0.28 / 1M (-75.0% vs. Tier 1)
